paragraphs: The XF 2.7d was introduced with the original X250-generation XF in 2007. It uses the Ford AJD V6 — a 2.7-litre diesel V6 shared with several Ford, Jaguar, and Land Rover vehicles of that era. The XF 2.7d remained in production until 2015, when the X260-generation XF replaced the X250. The 2.7d was discontinued during the X250 run — later X260 XFs used a different 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel from Jaguar's Ingenium family instead, not the AJD V6. Jaguar XF 2.7d Engine Compatibility The XF 2.7d uses the Ford AJD V6 throughout its production run — a 2.7-litre diesel V6 that remained consistent across the entire X250 generation. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford AJD V6 engines for every XF 2.7d on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XF 2.7d from 2023 to present. The Ford AJD V6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ford AJD V6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ford AJD V6 rebuild.
